jobs.location: REMOTE: North America / Europe, UTC-8 to UTC+2, Full-time Lokker is a privacy platform. You will develop and improve models that classify digital activity, identify meaningful privacy and security behaviors, and assess the confidence and significance of findings. If your best work is under NDA, say so and describe it in your own words. A human reads every application. No keyword filter, no automated rejection. jobs.title: Research Engineer (Speech AI/ML)
jobs.location: Remote (worldwide) Renaissance Philanthropy's aim is to activate a virtuous circle of increasing ambition and impact between philanthropists and innovators: by identifying frontier experts both in science and in new ways of solving problems; by tapping into the growing number of emerging philanthropists; and by building multi-sector initiatives that can harness the power of philanthropy, markets, and governments.
